accueil.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
accueil.faq.desc: Everything you need to know before getting started.
accueil.faq.1.a: Create a free account, choose your role (customer, vendor or driver) and start using the platform immediately.
accueil.faq.2.a: Customers only pay delivery fees (from 300 F). Vendors pay 0.6% commission on completed sales. Drivers keep 100% of delivery fees.
accueil.faq.3.a: Every transaction is protected by a unique confirmation code. Online Mobile Money payment eliminates fraud risks.
accueil.faq.4.a: We currently operate in Cotonou, Porto-Novo, Parakou and Abomey-Calavi. More cities coming soon.
accueil.faq.5.a: Yes! You need a zemidjan or vehicle, and a free registration. You can start delivering within 24 hours.
